Tube   select a profile to run firefox                                                              
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Profiles — ↑↓ jk: move · enter: run · a: add · e: open · d: delete · ?: keys · q: quit            
  Add — tab: complete · ↑↓: field · enter: add · esc: back                                          
  Question — y: yes · n esc enter: no                                                               
  Keys — any key: close                                                                             
                                                                                                    
Tube runs one application through a VPN, and only that application: nothing else of the machine uses
it.                                                                                                 
Without the VPN the application has no network at all: Tube never lets it use the machine's.        
A program that hands its work to one that already runs (a second firefox, a terminal's server) is   
not in the VPN.                                                                                     
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                                                                    
any key close
